notes: A new portal is named for the screen it is on: the monitor’s own name, shortened (“Xeneon Edge”, “Dell U2723QE”), or the screen’s shape when that name says nothing (“Bar”, “Round”, “Portrait”, “Square”, “Wide”). Two on one screen are told…

Naming: Rename… in a portal’s right-click opens its name in the Control Panel’s Portals tab, ready to type; a click on any portal’s name there does the same. Enter saves it, Escape keeps the old one, and a name you type is never changed by…
A portal named “Omen 2”, “Omen 3” or “New Panel” by an earlier version is named for its screen at start; names you typed are kept.
